891-2292-8207.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2999-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2999-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

3259-6633-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6633-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then The Fire Crystal can be omitted.

2073-4050-7877-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Voyager Glidecar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Voyager Glidecar enters, it and Kolodin trigger.
Resolve the Voyager Glidecar trigger, causing you to scry 1
Resolve the Kolodin trigger, causing Voyager Glidecar to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Voyager Glidecar.
When Voyager Glidecar dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2079-3132-3259.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
2079-3132-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3132-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-3259-7297.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-3259-7297.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3455-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3455-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Vizier of Many Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3455-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1580-4556-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

670-1619-1734-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-1734-6135.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, it triggers, returning Aarakocra Sneak from exile to the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2204-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scholar of New Horizons.
When Scholar of New Horizons dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1479-1671-7705.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Mole Man, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Mole Man trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-5256-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
978-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

856-4779-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

789-4050-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
789-4050-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Gutter Grime and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
789-4050-7084.notes: As Gutter Grime will get more and more slime counters, the final token you make will be infinitely large.

628-2034-7213.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Encumbered Reejerey.
When Encumbered Reejerey dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-3719-5326-7193.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Omni-Changeling and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Omni-Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Omni-Changeling to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Omni-Changeling enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Omni-Changeling by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

176-2921-6705.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-2921-6705.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Quina.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

323-4681-5170-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1013-1438.easyPrerequisites:
Hypervolt Grasp attached to Eater of the Dead.
Eater of the Dead does not have summoning sickness.
1013-1438.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Eater of the Dead deathtouch.
1013-1438.description:
Give Eater of the Dead deathtouch by any method.
Activate Eater of the Dead by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any nontoken creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies due to Eater of the Dead's deathtouch.
Activate Eater of the Dead by paying {0}, exiling the creature card from its owner's graveyard  and untapping Eater of the Dead.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

967-2511-3809-4365-7087.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

57-2751-4846-5223.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-2751-4846-5223.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

883-1497-5220-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1374-3136-4465.description:
Activate Changeling Outcast by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Changeling Outcast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2350-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1558-4447-6704.easyPrerequisites:
Other creatures you control have power 3 or greater.
An opponent cannot block RMS Titanic.
1558-4447-6704.description:
Activate RMS Titanic's crew ability by tapping any number of creatures with power 3 or greater,  causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Assault Suit's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to RMS Titanic.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using RMS Titanic, triggering its ability, causing you to not sacrifice it due to Assault Suit and create nine Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1305-4417-5200-6674.easyPrerequisites: Rydia does not have summoning sickness.
974-1305-4417-5200-6674.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Rydia by paying {5} and tapping it, returning There and Back Again from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. As There and Back Again enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing the finality counter from There and Back Again.
Resolve the There and Back Again trigger, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering its ability, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {9}{B}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Rydia.
Repeat from step 2.
974-1305-4417-5200-6674.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

855-1491-2033-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
855-1491-2033-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
855-1491-2033-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

222-527-1849-2921.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1849-2921.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1432-1876-2821-3201.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth of the Healing House and Minamo do not have summoning sickness.
Arixmethes is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
1432-1876-2821-3201.description:
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Minamo to become a 4/4 Elemental creature that's still a land.
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Minamo and Arixmethes.
Repeat from step 2.

647-3742-4251-4344-4875.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
"Samurai" chosen with Conspiracy.
647-3742-4251-4344-4875.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
When the token Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Godo until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
At the end of your combat phase, the token Lumbering Battlement triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
The token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4191-4616-5010.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {C}{C}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

193-1543-1887-2984.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional planeswalker.
193-1543-1887-2984.description:
Activate any other planeswalker you control by putting zero loyalty counters on it, putting a loyalty counter on Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Ugin.
Ugin enters the battlefield with fourteen loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Ugin by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1355-4235-4964.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four enchantments.
Sanctum Weaver and Niblis do not have summoning sickness.
1355-4235-4964.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Niblis by paying {U} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Niblis' ability, targeting Sanctum Weaver.
Resolve both Niblis abilities, untapping Niblis and Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

967-1806-2604-4666-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Planar Void triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Eternal Scourge for {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Eternal Scourge, allowing it to enter the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

404-1849-2105-2506.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent can not block your creatures.
"Human" or "Warrior" chosen with Molten Echoes.
404-1849-2105-2506.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R}.
Combat Celebrant enters the battlefield, triggering Molten Echoes, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
Move to your combat phase, attack with Ghired and Combat Celebrant.
Ghired triggers, creating a copy of Combat Celebrant token.
Exert Combat Celebrant, untapping all other creatures you control, gaining additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 4.
